_comment: Anchor data and error model for the extrapolation. User overrides are layered on top in the workspace; this packaged file is never edited at run time.

extra_sys.why: SSC13 ab initio and Theodosiou/NIST values differ above n~8

NIST measurements and all-order paper disagree up to 20% in D at n=12
no Fr anchor above 8p; a core pole between none and 9 eV changes 7s->np1/2 at n=20-40 by a factor of 2-3
no Fr anchor above 8p; core-pole choices change 7s->np3/2 by up to 10% at n=20-40

precision_anchors.src: Tran Tan & Derevianko 2023, <6S||D||nP_J> (e a0), (D, relative unc in D); NOT yet verified against the PDF; Fr: Roberts, Fairhall & Ginges, Phys. Rev. A 107, 052812 (2023), Table X final values (arXiv:2211.11134)

unreliable_tp_tags.T6898: the Fr 7s->np rows of NIST source T6898 split each multiplet 1:2 between p1/2 and p3/2 and disagree with the all-order values (Roberts et al. 2023) by a factor 2 (8p3/2) to 2.2 (8p1/2), growing to 20x for p1/2 at n=20
